name: Terraform Code Standards
description: Terraform guidance to adapt when converting to MDC. Regex patterns are illustrative, not enforcement or complete detection. Based on terraform-infrastructure.md and project-specific-standards.md.
author: Promptcraft

rules.message: Enable encryption and state locking supported by the backend and pinned Terraform version. S3 supports use_lockfile; DynamoDB locking is deprecated and coexistence is only a legacy-client migration option. See https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/backend/s3#state-locking
Terraform version must be pinned in versions.tf
Provider versions must be pinned in versions.tf
Never hardcode secrets in Terraform files. Use variables, data sources, or secret management.
Resource names should follow consistent naming patterns
Variables should be defined in variables.tf with type and description
